paper_title: Audio-Visual Efficient Conformer for Robust Speech Recognition
caption: Audio-only back-end modules FLOPs (Billion).
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the Module Giga FLOPs for different attention mechanisms across three stages of an Audio back-end Conformer Stage. The horizontal axis contains the stage labels, specifically Stage 1 (d=180, n=500), Stage 2 (d=256, n=250), and Stage 3 (d=360, n=125). The vertical axis represents Module Giga FLOPs, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.3, and tick labels at regular intervals of 0.1. There are four groups of bars, each representing a different attention mechanism: attention, grouped attention (g=3), patch attention (k=3), and feed-forward. The attention bars are blue, with the Stage 1 bar at approximately 0.28, Stage 2 at 0.15, and Stage 3 at 0.11. The grouped attention bars are red, with values around 0.15 for all stages. The patch attention bars are yellow, with values around 0.12 for all stages. The feed-forward bars are green, with values of approximately 0.12 for Stage 1, 0.13 for Stage 2, and 0.14 for Stage 3. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlining.
